content:
Group the base-3 digits into pairs from left to right (equivalently from right, since the length is even):

\[
12,\ 11,\ 22,\ 11,\ 12,\ 22,\ 11,\ 11,\ 22,\ 22
\]

Convert each base-3 pair to a base-9 digit:

\[
12_3=5,\quad 11_3=4,\quad 22_3=8
\]

So the base-9 representation begins:

\[
5484584488
\]

Thus the first digit is \(5\).

\[
\boxed{5}
\]
